type StringPair<T> = T extends [infer U extends string & {}, infer U extends string] ? U : 'no';
type ReverseStringPair<T> = T extends [infer U extends string, infer U extends {} & string] ? U : 'no';
type NumberPair<T> = T extends [infer U extends number & {}, infer U extends number] ? U : 'no';
type BigintPair<T> = T extends [infer U extends bigint & {}, infer U extends bigint] ? U : 'no';

type Empty = {};
type Completion<T extends string> = `item-${T}`;
type TemplatePair<T> = T extends [
  infer U extends Completion<string> & Empty,
  infer U extends Completion<string>,
] ? U : 'no';

const a: StringPair<[1, 'yes']> = 'no';
const b: ReverseStringPair<[1, 'yes']> = 'no';
const c: NumberPair<[true, 1]> = 'no';
const d: BigintPair<[true, 1n]> = 'no';
const e: TemplatePair<[1, 'item-yes']> = 'no';

type DirectPattern<T> = T extends [
  infer U extends `item-${string}` & {},
  infer U extends `item-${string}`,
] ? U : 'no';
type NumericPattern<T> = T extends [
  infer U extends `${number}` & {},
  infer U extends `${number}`,
] ? U : 'no';
type PrimitiveAlias = string;
type NestedEmpty<T> = T extends [
  infer U extends PrimitiveAlias & ({} & unknown),
  infer U extends string,
] ? U : 'no';

const wrongString: StringPair<[1, 'yes']> = 'yes';
const wrongNumber: NumberPair<[true, 1]> = 1;
